notes: RBox expansion paired with history-replace-0010 (which makes 'was a vassal of' symmetric): a made-up relation, thistle_bound_to, is given the same property, applied to the same real rulers (William of Normandy and Philip I, John and Philip II). The cross-lingual prompts keep the coined term untranslated, with a directed particle (于, a), so no Chinese or Spanish word for 'bound' brings its own symmetry.
